name: mind-z-tool
description: Open-source-first creator operating system with resilient local, MCP, API and browser routing.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @creator-nexus/core && npm run build -w @creator-nexus/adapters && npm run build -w @mind-z/runtime && npm run build -w @mind-z/mcp && npm run build -w @mind-z/browser && npm run build -w @mind-z/virality && npm run build -w @mind-z/publishing && npm run build -w @mind-z/gateway && npm run build -w @creator-nexus/studio
scripts.build:preview: npm run build -w @creator-nexus/core && npm run build -w @creator-nexus/studio
scripts.test: node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/verify-architecture.mjs && node scripts/runtime-regression.mjs
